title: Delegate tasks to AI interns (agents)
cardDesc: A personal OS with infinite specialized agents controlled through Slack
thumbnail: /assets/images/Delegate Tasks to AI Interns Hero Image.png

sections.title: Agents Are Like Interns
sections.content: Give them tools, context, and instructions. They figure out the rest. I use them to automate tasks I know how to do but don't want to spend time on.

sections.title: One-off workflows: Perplexity Comet
items: Finding discount codes at checkout (life saver): it searches through the web and applies every code it could find and gives you the best deal

Research background of Luma event attendees: Log in to Luma events page, have Comet click through each attendee and search for their background. With this, I could now go into the event with some basic understanding of the group.

sections.title: Key benefits
items: Zero setup—spin it up instantly
Works with login-required tools—log in once, then let it execute
No configuration needed for one-time tasks

sections.title: Recurring workflows: Gumloop with Slack
sections.content: I built a personal operating system with Slack as the control center. Each channel houses specialized agents with MCP connections to GSuite, Exa (for web search), and Apollo (for contacts). I have 2 channels in my personal Slack (still expanding):

sections.title: #job-openings (1 agent)
items: Consolidates job postings from 4 Berkeley Slack channels (past 48hrs)
Searches LinkedIn for Summer 2026 MBA internships in PM/operations/GTM
Delivers: Company + Role + Description + Contact/Link
Eliminates daily manual searching and reading through messy slack channels

sections.title: #network (3 agents managing professional network)
sections.content: Add network (Tools: Apollo, Exa, Gmail, Google Sheet)
items: Input: LinkedIn URL + context about how we met and other info
Agent researches: work experience, education, posts, press coverage
Finds email via Apollo
Drafts personalized follow-up email
Adds complete profile to my Google Sheet database

sections.title: Update network (Tools: Google Sheet)
items: Input: Contact name + new information to log
Agent finds person in database, clarifies if needed
Appends new data without replacing existing info

sections.title: Find network (Tools: Google Sheet, Gmail, Calendar, Exa)
items: Input: Keywords (e.g., "people from Google", "met 2 months ago")
Agent searches database for matches
Researches recent updates: job changes, LinkedIn posts, company news
Checks Gmail/Calendar for last interaction
Delivers: Connections + relevance + research + last contact date

paragraphs: What's magical: a single interface to command infinite agents without juggling multiple tools.
